specs.title: Keep pending MCP file reads from replacing newer import drafts
specs.why: MCP file-import completion looks up whichever import panel currently exists and replaces its text. Later typing, or Cancel followed by a fresh import form, can therefore lose its draft to an older file selection.
specs.measured: Actual Import -> From file -> picker Path callback -> real to_thread read. Both same-panel typing and Cancel/reopen replacement retain later-draft before release, then receive older fixture JSON. Untouched-panel control loads normally. Fake hub only supplies catalog; no credentials or network.
ac: An untouched originating import panel receives its explicitly selected file normally.
Typing or clearing the import text after file selection remains visible when the older read completes, including invalid raw drafts.
Cancel, replacement or reopening invalidates the old panel read so it cannot publish into a new import panel.
Mounted checks cover the actual picker callback and filesystem await with same-panel, replacement and ordinary controls.
specs.book_basis: PDF145–146 and158 / printed136–137 and149 explains widget queues and asynchronous handlers. Originating panel/draft identity is an application-specific deduction.
specs.dedup: TASK-32791 covers workspace-root drafts, TASK-32780/32787 Tool Pack review/write lifetimes, TASK-32839 recovery-review completion and TASK-36361 other Settings drafts. Their complete acceptance criteria do not own MCP server JSON file-import publication.
specs.adr_reason: Routine stale UI publication repair within existing import-panel/workbench ownership and the canonical Settings host; no new service or permission boundary.

specs.title: Reject malformed MCP import shapes without losing the editable panel
specs.why: The MCP JSON importer assumes args is iterable and env is a mapping. Valid JSON with malformed field containers escapes Preview validation, causing the error keepalive to retire the import panel and its editable draft.
specs.measured: Real Preview of args:42 raises TypeError; env:[not-an-object] raises AttributeError. Valid args:[]/env:{} control passes. Installed keepalive guard keeps the host alive while the failing panel/editor detach. No verified whole-app production crash claim.
ac: Malformed args/env container shapes produce a clear import validation error without an uncaught handler exception.
Rejected source text stays editable, Import remains disabled, and stale preview candidates cannot be submitted.
Correcting the text and pressing Preview recovers normally; supported valid and omitted field shapes retain existing behavior.
Parser and mounted Preview regressions cover both observed malformed shapes, a valid control and the installed keepalive semantics.
specs.book_basis: Collateral concrete input-boundary defect found while tracing the book’s queued Preview/panel lifecycle model. Container validation is an existing application requirement, rather than a specific book design.
specs.dedup: TASK-241 remains open for regex alignment, mutation remount, slot confirmation and lifecycle cancellation; its complete criteria do not cover malformed containers. TASK-26013 validates spawn-command shapes, TASK-14922 protocol/packaging. TASK-32533 and TASK-33621.13 keep handler errors alive while retiring failing pumps; they do not validate these JSON shapes.
specs.adr_reason: Routine validation and recoverable errors within the existing importer and host; no new service or security policy.

task_spec_sanity.measurement_limits: Clearing/invalid-raw draft variants, correction after validation rejection, stale candidate invalidation and omitted-field compatibility are desired future AC coverage. This revalidation does not claim all those unimplemented outcomes were measured.
